mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate prolonged accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 consecutive months (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by >1% from prior month signal broad demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both decline >1% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100 for three consecutive months) signals manufacturing slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as supply chain risks materialize.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) consistently supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 100k (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Core CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent price pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as rate hike expectations accelerate.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by >1% coupled with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.1pp increase) signals severe demand collapse, producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST decline >1% and UNRATE rises >0.1pp (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) consistently reduce equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
